1.web: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
1.asv: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and knownme.

2.web: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.
2.asv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.

3.web: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
3.asv: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.

4.web: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.
4.asv: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

5.web: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.
5.asv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.

6.web: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.
6.asv: Suchknowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.

7.web: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
7.asv: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

8.web: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!
8.asv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.

9.web: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea;
9.asv: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

10.web: Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
10.asv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.

11.web: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night”;
11.asv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;

12.web: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.
12.asv: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both aliketo thee.

13.web: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
13.asv: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother’s womb.

14.web: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
14.asv: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.

15.web: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
15.asv: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

16.web: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
16.asv: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, Eventhe days that were ordainedfor me, When as yet there was none of them.

17.web: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
17.asv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

18.web: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
18.asv: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.

19.web: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
19.asv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.

20.web: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.
20.asv: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take thy name in vain.

21.web: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
21.asv: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

22.web: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
22.asv: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.

23.web: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.
23.asv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;

24.web: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
24.asv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
